text: So we built our own tools, to make every team more efficient.
SF Pricing turns a client brief into a Good, Better, Best plan.
It's trained on our own projects, pricing patterns, and costs,
then drafts a starting point.
Our team reviews every number,
and a person makes the final call.
Hundreds of thousands of dollars of projects, priced so far.
Store Walk turns field photos into retail evidence.
Every shelf shot gets tagged,
so anyone can search it in plain English.
It drafts a pitch from what we actually saw,
and our team takes it from there.
And AI Training keeps the whole team current.
Our AI team tracks the industry and the news,
then carefully designs every lesson and assignment.
Lessons land in everyone's quarterly checklist.
Our automations run whole workflows, end to end:
SEO content, survey media named and centralized,
and new leads, enriched, located, and sent weekly.
Same playbook everywhere:
dashboards, pipelines, catalog audits.
And we extend these capabilities to our client work,
delivering a fantastic client experience.
